text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR’S REPORT dated November 6, 2026, relative to the Transfer of
  Ownership of Absoltue Tow Service, Inc., to Mr. Jon Nissley, Owner of Kelmark Tow, as set forth.
  [BPC #26-344]
  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Executive Director’s report and TRANSMIT to City Council.
summary: The Board is asked to approve a transfer of ownership of Absoltue Tow Service, Inc. to Jon Nissley, owner of Kelmark Tow, and to send the matter to City Council.
